objective: Forward verified non-Season2 NativeAd first-view responsiveness/recovery to Season2 staging publisher *source only* without triggering EAS OTA, changing release markers, backend rewards or production.
productionBaselineEvidence: Current staged publisher SHA 1a28cd593f06b1b655b1747550b37b2f56a3e974 has exactly main baseline AdMob file blobs; forward port six exact QA-passed PR #982 source/test blob contents also in production candidate PR #986 head fc65e8b9791b04dc12f6b7a68f82612b41f6da1d. No AdMob actual Android live verification or EAS OTA publication claimed. Staging billing guard remains held.
chosenApproach: 9-second bounded first-view/warmup native timeout, shared two-failure/5-minute local banner-first health, and full requested banner viewport only after an allowed reservation. Preserve 12-second native feed timeout on slow 3G.
preserveBehaviors: Do not change ad SDK/native package, ad IDs, test/live app identity, consent, remote locks, cooldown, or app native runtime.
No synthetic impressions or requests, auto-refresh, illegal off-screen SDK views, forced interstitials, extra requests, or reward changes.
AdMob production, RC and staging remain untouched until exact mandatory CI and runtime checks; Season2 untouched.
Loaded native creatives and offscreen viewability rules remain unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Shared health counts prewarm and onscreen NativeAd failures per stable placement, expires and clears on success
BannerAd is never clipped during a pending real SDK load
Failed/no-fill slots collapse to compact probe and maintain existing quiet-period retries
Source and tests in isolated PR; no automatic production publish or payout changes
Staging release marker unchanged and zero-charge fail-closed; do not publish staging or production from this PR.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Android ad fallback surface and asynchronous NativeAd lifecycle are changed on first-view dashboards.
preservedBehaviors: Keep live app routes, native runtime, 3G feed loading and offscreen visibility restrictions unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: NativeAd failure recovery, prewarm and BannerAd loading geometry impact protected AdMob first-view delivery.
preservedBehaviors: Preserve real AdMob SDK callbacks, consent, placement identity, pacing, cash/QMP Finance separation and production app ID.

selectionRationale: BUKLOD live client telemetry is dominated by native loading timeouts, not a lack of ad placements. Shared prewarm/onscreen health and format-sized BannerAd loading directly address observed failure while preserving real AdMob SDK events, user consent, cooldown and no-OTA safety.
alternativeApproaches: Make every dashboard issue concurrent native and banner requests (rejected: request spam and extra network load).
Remove shared two-minute remount cooldown (rejected: risks accidental rapid refresh and policy violations).
Change production unit IDs or native SDK without verified Android artifact (rejected: unnecessary native risk).
Silently fabricate missing AdMob impressions in client telemetry (rejected: dishonest and violates revenue integrity).
releaseTarget: Staging OTA source only; no marker update or EAS publish
